title: NH-48 Flyover Repair: Service Lane Diversion at Rajiv Chowk
content: Flyover joint repair underway on NH-48 towards Jaipur. Heavy traffic diverted via service lane near Rajiv Chowk for 48 hours. Commuters advised to use alternate routes.

title: Farrukhnagar Grain Mandi: Mustard Procurement Starts Monday
content: Farrukhnagar Anaaj Mandi will commence government MSP procurement for mustard from Monday 8 AM. Farmers must bring Meri Fasal Mera Byora registration slips.
